lines.2: 「None at all... Bet you didn't do any better.」
lines.3: 「Me? I just had fruit and shellfish for lunch.」
lines.5: 「I guess it's easier to find food by the sea than up in the mountains...」
lines.6: 「I saved some for you too. Here.」
lines.10: 「Well, that's what usually happens. I had this scroll, too--」
lines.14: With that, she ran off toward the sea.
lines.15: 「...Would you at least let me finish?」
lines.16: 「Oh well. I've had lunch, so I guess I'll head into the mountains next.」
lines.19: After calling that out to Konoe, I headed for the mountain trail.
lines.21: 「Fish... I don't like it, but I don't have much choice now.」
lines.22: 「After what I said to Tsushima, I have to manage on my own.」
lines.23: 「Let's see... There's fishing gear in the cabin.」
lines.24: 「But I don't have any bait... What do I do?」
lines.25: 「...Oh! If I use crumbs from my peanut-butter bread as bait, maybe it'll work.」
lines.26: 「...There. Pretty clever, if I do say so myself.」
lines.28: 「Heh-heh. I've got a feeling they're really going to bite.」
lines.30: 「W-what the heck? Not a single bite.」
lines.31: 「Damn it. I'll just catch one with my bare hands.」
lines.32: 「I'm in the drama club... If I get into character as an ama diver, I should be able to catch one.」
lines.33: Once she waded in up to her knees, she could clearly see the fish swimming through the water.
lines.34: 「All right... I'm an ama diver. A forty-year-old veteran out catching fish for my no-good husband again today--that's the setup!」
lines.40: 「Ngh, stop darting around... Don't run away!」
